title: Explicit solvers in Python for the symbolic system: explicit Euler, velocity Verlet, RK44
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.56: before the generalized-alpha solver, constant step size explicit Euler, velocity Verlet and RK44 in exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py, with the settings of SimulationSettings.timeIntegration and checked against SolveDynamic with the same DynamicSolverType; for simple user items (mass points, spring-dampers); the solvers take any system with the interface of SymbolicSystem, also one written with numpy. The concept first, in docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SolveExplicit(system, simulationSettings, solverType): explicit Euler, RK44 and velocity Verlet with constant step size on a SymbolicSystemBase, as Exudyn's explicit solver computes them, with the mass matrix inverted per body (timeIntegration.explicit.computeMassMatrixInversePerBody) or solved as a whole, and for a SymbolicSystem the solution file and the sensors of its mbs; NumpySystem for equations written with numpy; MassMatrixBlocks for the blocks of the bodies.
